boundaries.name: rust-semantics
boundaries.obligation: The Lean model is handwritten; nothing proves it refines the Rust source, rustc lowering, integer wrapping, or panic behaviour.

boundaries.name: floating-point-arithmetic
boundaries.obligation: All f64 / Complex64 computation (FFT, LDL tree, Gram-Schmidt norms, the Gaussian sampler's exp approximation) is treated as an opaque dependency; no IEEE-754 semantics are modelled.

boundaries.name: goldilocks-field-encoding
boundaries.obligation: The mapping of bytes and limbs into plonky2 Goldilocks elements (from_canonical_u32/u64, to_canonical_u64) is assumed canonical and injective on the stated ranges.

boundaries.name: machine-integer-wrapping
boundaries.obligation: i16/u16/u32/u128 wrap-around, casts and shift semantics are modelled by Nat/Int operations chosen to match on the ranges reached; out-of-range behaviour is not covered.
